ai.headline: Search impressions badh rahe hain (138 total), par monitoring bot ko Cloudflare ne block kiya hai
ai.summary: Google Search Console mein impressions 0 se badhkar 138 ho gaye hain (avg position ~36.4), par abhi clicks 0 hain. Technical code checks pass hain (27 pages scan hue, 0 errors). Ek issue ye hai ki hamare automated test bot ko Cloudflare edge ne 403 challenge dekar block kiya, jisse 7 paths check nahi ho paaye. AdSense ke liye abhi apply nahi karna hai (0/200 clicks target pura nahi hua). Hamara $5,000 monthly goal ek flexible planning estimate hai, koi pakka promise nahi.
youDo: Cloudflare Dashboard (dash.cloudflare.com) mein Security Events check karo: automated checks block ho rahe hain. Normal browser mein homemoneycalc.com khol kar confirm karo ki real visitors ke liye site chal rahi hai (15 mins).
Growth checklist se free Ahrefs Webmaster Tools (ahrefs.com/webmaster-tools) setup karo taaki backlinks track ho sakein (20 mins).
Open Enrollment season (Nov 1 se) ke liye /paycheck-calculator/ par 401(k) aur HSA changes ka ek chhota sa take-home example preview check kar lo (20 mins).
agentNext: Holiday Budget Calculator roadmap launch (target 2026-11-01) ki code readiness verify karna.

risks: Cloudflare ne 7 internal monitoring checks block kiye — site down nahi hai par bot-monitoring adhuri reh gayi.
